bipolar_pulse.coverage: dominant low-frequency adjacent-SISO structure inside the declared task band
bipolar_pulse.known_limit: does not close an unprobed fast-mode obligation above the declared bipolar-pulse excitation band

bounded_modal_probe.coverage: dominant adjacent-SISO structure plus the registered bounded modal sweep band
bounded_modal_probe.known_limit: does not establish behavior above the compiled sweep band or outside the declared operating region

bounded_bidirectional_staircase.coverage: matched up/down local static-map and stable-dwell evidence
bounded_bidirectional_staircase.known_limit: does not identify dynamic hysteresis or a nonsettling operating point

bounded_two_level_multisine.coverage: registered task-band frequency lines at two bounded amplitudes
bounded_two_level_multisine.known_limit: does not distinguish self-excitation from amplitude-dependent damping without release evidence

amplitude_stratified_release.coverage: amplitude-stratified zero-input decay with public position and velocity signals
amplitude_stratified_release.known_limit: resolves tested-region decay structure but does not estimate signed actuator input gain or task-band forced-response coverage

bounded_two_level_multisine_then_amplitu.coverage: two-level task-band frequency evidence plus amplitude-stratified zero-input decay
bounded_two_level_multisine_then_amplitu.known_limit: requires public position and velocity signals and remains local to the tested amplitude region

safe_downward_release_and_pulse.coverage: stable-configuration releases and signed pulse pairs for a measurable local unstable variable
safe_downward_release_and_pulse.known_limit: does not authorize swing-up, unmeasured-state stabilization, or global nonlinear control

bounded_mimo_dc_then_hadamard_multisine.coverage: registered 2x2 DC pairing and coded task-band frequency evidence
bounded_mimo_dc_then_hadamard_multisine.known_limit: does not cover nonsquare, underactuated, or robust-MIMO output-feedback design

indistinguishable_hypotheses: private mechanisms with the same low-frequency trace
possible_same_results: different stable structures can share gain and dominant time constant
bipolar_pulse.ambiguous_result_next_step: run bounded_modal_probe when the fast-mode obligation remains unresolved
bipolar_pulse.capability_gap_condition: the required discriminator is outside the pulse band or no compatible public repeat exists
bipolar_pulse.valid_working_region: declared SISO task band and bounded pulse amplitude

distinguishable_hypotheses: modal feature inside compiled sweep band
possible_same_results: a missing modal feature may mean absence or insufficient excitation
bounded_modal_probe.ambiguous_result_next_step: retain the high-frequency blocker and use a registered repeat only for quality failure
bounded_modal_probe.capability_gap_condition: fast-mode resolution is required but no public bounded modal protocol is compatible
bounded_modal_probe.valid_working_region: compiled modal sweep band and declared local operating region

possible_same_results: dead zone and weak gain can overlap within noise
bounded_bidirectional_staircase.ambiguous_result_next_step: repeat matched up/down levels with retained dwell and quality audit
bounded_bidirectional_staircase.capability_gap_condition: static inversion or hysteresis resolution is required but public dwell evidence is unavailable
bounded_bidirectional_staircase.valid_working_region: tested levels with declared dwell and local map region

possible_same_results: nonlinearity and noise can produce overlapping residual indices
bounded_two_level_multisine.ambiguous_result_next_step: retain the dynamic-nonlinearity blocker and request registered release evidence when available
bounded_two_level_multisine.capability_gap_condition: self-excitation or unmeasured dynamic nonlinearity cannot be separated by registered public actions
bounded_two_level_multisine.valid_working_region: declared task band and tested amplitude levels
bounded_two_level_multisine.independent_verification_source: deterministic FRF repeat and residual audit

indistinguishable_hypotheses: global behavior outside tested release region
possible_same_results: noise and finite-duration truncation can mimic weak decay
amplitude_stratified_release.ambiguous_result_next_step: repeat releases for quality; otherwise retain controller qualification gap
amplitude_stratified_release.capability_gap_condition: controller synthesis requires signed input gain or forced-response coverage absent from release data
measurement_quality_requirements: fit residual and lower decay bound
amplitude_stratified_release.valid_working_region: tested release amplitudes and declared local region

distinguishable_hypotheses: task-band response plus local amplitude-dependent decay
indistinguishable_hypotheses: global nonlinear behavior outside tested region
possible_same_results: different mechanisms can share FRF and release summaries
bounded_two_level_multisine_then_amplitu.ambiguous_result_next_step: retain unresolved mechanism and require a supported public discriminator
bounded_two_level_multisine_then_amplitu.capability_gap_condition: combined evidence is insufficient for a registered controller contract
bounded_two_level_multisine_then_amplitu.valid_working_region: tested task-band amplitudes and release region

possible_same_results: local rates can overlap across different nonlinear balances
safe_downward_release_and_pulse.ambiguous_result_next_step: repeat the bounded stable release and signed pulse pair or report a local-balance gap
safe_downward_release_and_pulse.capability_gap_condition: required internal measurement or signed authority is unavailable

possible_same_results: different channel dynamics can share condition and residual summaries
bounded_mimo_dc_then_hadamard_multisine.ambiguous_result_next_step: repeat DC and coded multisine evidence or retain MIMO capability gap
bounded_mimo_dc_then_hadamard_multisine.capability_gap_condition: required channel or robust output-feedback evidence is outside the registered 2x2 protocol
measurement_quality_requirements: bootstrap pairing and inverse residual bounds
bounded_mimo_dc_then_hadamard_multisine.valid_working_region: declared 2x2 task band and tested channel amplitudes
bounded_mimo_dc_then_hadamard_multisine.independent_verification_source: deterministic pairing, conditioning, and residual audit

principles: The executor never accepts template identifiers, hidden truth, expected classes, or reference routes.
The LLM proposes a revisable structure and one information action; deterministic rules compile the executable protocol.
Every compiler change records its reason, added data cost, and the blocking risk it removes.
A retry is permitted only for a named gray-zone or data-quality failure and is never silently converted into another controller.

Routes explicitly listed as unsupported remain capability gaps. Previously unseen planner routes remain unregistered, unverified provisional proposals in an independent-simulation queue; they receive no evidence or authorization credit.
Explicit task bandwidth and engineering units scale protocol time, frequency, amplitude, sampling, features, and the controller runtime normalization contract.
Physical evidence requires protocol-conformant raw records, excitation sufficiency, an immutable controller freeze, and confidence-bound performance adjudication.

Topology is resolved before scalar preclassification. A Step-B flag can authorize a staircase only for SISO tasks with public route-changing static-nonlinearity evidence and a credible stable-dwell premise; A+B, MIMO+B, and nonsettling+B combinations remain explicit capability gaps.

siso_repeated_timeseries.scope: SISO Class I-III, stable output-only NMP, and Step-A high-frequency modal screening

step_b_repeated_staircase.scope: memoryless invertible map, dead zone, hysteresis, and non-monotone static-map counterexamples

class_iv_frequency_repeats.scope: stable higher-order minimum-phase task-band reduction and output-only amplitude-dependent dynamics

class_iv_amplitude_release_repeats.scope: local SISO amplitude-dependent damping or a single-mode self-excited oscillation with measured position and velocity, adequate release-model fit, signed actuation, and task bandwidth covered by the measured FRF band

class_iv_release_repeats.scope: local zero-input decay sign and amplitude dependence with measured position and velocity; controller synthesis remains blocked until signed input gain and task-band forced-response coverage exist

unstable_local_balance_repeats.scope: local gravity-dominated unstable balance with a measurable internal variable, an outer task variable, and a stable alternative probe configuration

class_v_mimo_summary.scope: 2x2 channelwise, static coupling, in-band dynamic coupling, and fragile inversion triage

retry_policy.siso_repeated_timeseries: replace a bipolar pulse with a bounded modal probe, or add two repeats if already modal
retry_policy.step_b_repeated_staircase: repeat the same bidirectional levels with two additional complete cycles
retry_policy.class_iv_frequency_repeats: repeat the same two amplitude levels and frequency lines with two additional retained periods
retry_policy.class_iv_amplitude_release_repeats: repeat the same two-level frequency lines and amplitude-stratified zero-input releases twice more
retry_policy.class_iv_release_repeats: repeat the same amplitude-stratified zero-input releases twice more
retry_policy.unstable_local_balance_repeats: repeat the same stable-configuration release and signed pulse pairs twice more
retry_policy.class_v_mimo_summary: repeat the same DC and coded multisine design with two additional repeats

post_controller_adjudication.precondition: task_contract.performance_requirements is fixed before planning and controller compilation
post_controller_adjudication.binding: SHA-256 over candidate route, controller result, and consumed feature records
post_controller_adjudication.rule: Provider-private model information may be used only after controller compilation and may never revise the diagnostic, feature, or controller record.
post_controller_adjudication.statistical_gate: The pre-registered perturbed success-rate threshold is applied to the 95% Wilson lower confidence bound, not to the point estimate.
post_controller_adjudication.physical_gate: A physical provider requires prior physical identification data from the compiled protocol, persisted raw trajectories, and controller_freeze.json; a physical adjudication is immutable.
